originated_lines.note: This is the only file in the repository with exactly 136 rows, which is where the brief's '136-game log' most plausibly comes from. It is a full-season schedule with a fair line for every fixture and a market value only where a third-party archive had one.

standings_cross_check.caution: An odd team-game total means at least one game is counted for only one club (a postponed/cancelled game). The implied count is an upper bound: it assumes every counted game was a normal two-club game.
